verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a fair question for an online tax-services platform, but nothing in the evidence shows the IRS letting users define rules that fire actions on events. MeF 'business rules' are IRS-side validation rules for submitted returns, not user-defined triggers. The A2A and MeF channels are credentialed submission rails, not event-driven automation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
